from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_chat import validate_request,validate_result
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_record import normalized_run_files
T='A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R4P3'
req=Path('control/model_execution/direct_requests')/(T+'.json')
res=Path('control/model_execution/direct_results')/(T+'.json')
rq=json.loads(req.read_text()); rr=json.loads(res.read_text())
validate_request(rq); validate_result(rq,rr)
assert rr['completion_sha256']=='ee8cb3d10a02d50064dcea2fd7aa4264fe2fabbb04c0f4ab58d01312fba6c918'
p=json.loads(rr['final'])
assert p['proposal_version']==5
assert {x['name'] for x in p['intended_artifacts']}=={'complement_checker_v4.py','test_complement_checker_v4.py','qualification_stream_v4.json'}
out=Path('control/dev_checks/r4p3_stage'); run=out/'run'; run.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
files=normalized_run_files(rq,rr)
[(run/n).write_text(v) for n,v in files.items()]
sha=lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
env={'schema':'PVA_GOVERNED_MODEL_COMPLETION_V1','task_id':T,'phase':rq['phase'],'model':'gpt-5.6-sol','model_policy':'SOL_EXACT','execution_layer':'DIRECT_SOL_CHAT','route_task_id':rq['delivery_route_task_id'],'campaign_id':rq['campaign_id'],'input_sha256':rq['input_sha256'],'checkpoint':'models/runs/'+T+'-direct-r4p3','completion_sha256':sha(run/'COMPLETE.json'),'worker_sha256':sha(run/'WORKER.json'),'request_sha256':sha(req),'direct_result_sha256':sha(res),'final':rr['final']}
(out/'model_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(env,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('R4P3_STAGE=PASS')
